    LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.lemma4c

    BO13a Lemma 4 c), first part #

    Let σ, ρ start at x, neither factoring through the other on the right, with ρ ≤ σ, i.e. σ = φ ≫ ρ ≫ ψ. If σ = γ ≫ δ and ρ = γ ≫ ρ' share the first factor γ, then δ is reducible (RayCat.lemma4c). The proof uses one-sided cyclicity of P(m, y₀), comparability, right cancellation and nilpotence of non-identity endomorphisms (the printed argument is garbled; this is a reconstruction).

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.lemma4c {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] [IsRayCategory P] [IsFiniteRayCategory P] (hQ : OneSidedCyclic P) (hR : RightCancel P) {x y₀ y₁ m : P} {σ : x ⟶ y₀} {ρ : x ⟶ y₁} (hv₁ : ¬∃ (c : y₁ ⟶ y₀), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ρ c = σ) (γ : x ⟶ m) (δ : m ⟶ y₀) (ρ' : m ⟶ y₁) (hσ : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp γ δ = σ) (hρ : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp γ ρ' = ρ) (φ : x ⟶ x) (ψ : y₁ ⟶ y₀) (hle : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp φ (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ρ ψ) = σ) (hσ0 : σ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (m' : P) (d₁ : m ⟶ m') (d₂ : m' ⟶ y₀), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp d₁ d₂ = δ ∧ ¬CategoryTheory.IsIso d₁ ∧ ¬CategoryTheory.IsIso d₂
